# Third-party libraries

- `three.min.js`: three.js r128 (https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js), MIT licence, copyright Three.js Authors.
- `OrbitControls.js`: `examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js` from three.js r128, also MIT.

They are kept in the repository so the page still opens without internet access or behind restricted networks, such as in a classroom.
